acceptance.decision: Adopt the explicit receding_recovery configuration as an optional quality-first path. Keep existing defaults and fixed personalities; do not claim universal intelligence or equal-compute superiority.
acceptance.criterion: Auction purpose improves across independent seeds; inspect every game/persona and investigate systematic loss. Fixed traits and rule adapters; no coefficients fitted to these results.
gains: Replan from the resolved owner after real feedback.
Represent bounded recovery by the learning future owner, rather than assuming exclusively reflex continuation.
All four game averages and persona averages improve against all four controls; all eight auction world-seed averages improve.
costs: Every-turn heavy planning and additional short lookahead inside predicted trajectories.
Remaining finite-horizon investment misses and model/sampling uncertainty.
preserved: Fixed traits, principles and policy coefficients.
Game rule adapters and fast baseline policy.
Independent real and imagined owner state and information boundaries.
limitations: Four supplied-rule worlds; eight auction world seeds, only two per other primary game and one per stress game.
Four negative persona-by-regime observed means are retained, not erased by post-hoc Bellman accounting.
No universal human-level, reactive-opponent, indefinite-world, psychological-validity or equal-compute claim.
Only the registered configuration is adopted; no global default switch.

resource_growth_shift_endpoint7.interpretation: This small observed loss is not assigned to personality. Conditional increments alone do not prove future policy value.

test_evidence.final_publication_ci: Requires the exact final main commit; not yet performed.
